facts.text: I want to install pi-Hole to block ads on my router.
I saw the message "static ip needed" during the pi-Hole setup.
I saw the message "Select a privacy mode for FTL/" during the pi-Hole setup.
My router product name is MediaAccess TG789vac v2.
My router hardware version is VANT-6.
My router serial number is CP2025TASMB.
My router MAC address is D4:35:1D:15:34:C6.
My router uptime is 6 days 7 hours 44 minutes 46 seconds.
I cannot find "Advance Settings" in my router interface.

In my router interface, I have these categories: Wireless, Broadband, Internet Acseses, Local Network, Telephony, WAN service, Content Sharing, Devices, Mobile, Management, Realy Setup, Diagnositic, Gateway.
Under the DHCP server section, I have an on/off option.

events.text: User starts pi-Hole installation to block ads on their router.
User encounters the message "static ip needed" during setup.
User encounters the prompt "Select a privacy mode for FTL/" during setup.
User finishes the pi-Hole installation and asks what to do next.
User provides router details including timezone Asia/Jerusalem and router system time 2023-01-14 18:59:13.
User cannot find "Advance Settings" and lists available router categories.
